lines: {name}, Other Selling Shareholder, receives money from selling {shares_offered} in the offer for sale.
{proceeds} is in hand since {timing_date}, {event_age}, the listing date in the timetable.
They keep {retained_shares}, locked in for six months from allotment, so more value follows later.
Caveat: average cost of acquisition is unconfirmed, so the taxable gain cannot be stated yet.
